name: Redis MCP Server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C3, C4, C7, C8, C10; partly meets C5, C6; does not meet C2, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The PyPI record for redis-mcp-server 0.5.1 links the repository, and PyPI holds a provenance attestation for the release naming `redis/mcp-redis` (workflow `release.yml`) as publisher.

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected" and offers no private vulnerability reporting; the README names no channel for security reports (searched for: security@, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, report security).

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 0.5.1 is dated 2026-08-05; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-11; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-11.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: No server-side read-only switch is described; the README documents restricting access through a Redis ACL user. Searched `README.md` for: --read-only, READ_ONLY, read-only mode. Quoted: “You can configure Redis ACL to restrict the access to the Redis database. For example, to create a read-only user:”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Both command-line arguments and environment variables are documented; the connection address format shown can carry a password. Quoted: “The Redis MCP Server can be configured in two ways: via command line arguments or via environment variables.”; “redis://user:secret@localhost:6379/0?foo=bar&qux=baz”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`uv.lock`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: mcp[cli]<2,>=1.26.0. Lower-bound version 1.26.0 of mcp (PyPI) was published on 2026-01-24, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
